description: Defines the ProxyConfigServiceLinux class and its nested Delegate and SettingGetter classes, which implement system proxy configuration retrieval for Linux environments, including environment variables, gconf, gsettings, and kioslaverc. Contains method declarations, enums, and class interfaces related to proxy settings management.

classes.name: ProxyConfigServiceLinux
classes.description: Implements system proxy configuration retrieval for Linux, managing environment variables and system settings, and notifying observers of changes.

classes.name: ProxyConfigServiceLinux::Delegate
classes.description: Handles the actual fetching and updating of proxy configurations, managing notifications, and observer callbacks.

classes.name: ProxyConfigServiceLinux::SettingGetter
classes.description: Abstract interface for retrieving proxy settings from system sources like gconf, gsettings, or configuration files.

methods.name: SetupAndFetchInitialConfig
methods.description: Initializes configuration fetching and notification setup.

methods.name: OnCheckProxyConfigSettings
methods.description: Triggers a re-fetch of proxy configuration based on current system settings.

methods.name: AddObserver
methods.description: Adds an observer to be notified of proxy configuration changes.

methods.name: GetLatestProxyConfig
methods.description: Retrieves the most recent proxy configuration.

methods.name: PostDestroyTask
methods.description: Posts a task to safely destroy the delegate and stop notifications.

methods.name: OnDestroy
methods.description: Stops change notifications and cleans up resources.
